newsitem.title: MEXICO: Radiocel may list on Mexico bourse in June - source.
newsitem.headline: Radiocel may list on Mexico bourse in June - source.

text.p: Mexican paging company Radiocel may make an initial public offering (IPO) and begin listing on the Mexican bourse during the first half of June, a source close to the deal said on Monday.
"We are beginning the paperwork and the IPO is still subject to approval by the National Banking and Securities Commission (CNBV)," the source said.
"If market conditions are favorable, we will list during the first half of June, and if not, in September," she added.
The source said the company was still "fine-tuning" the percentage of its equity it aimed to offer.
Radiocel would undertake the IPO through its subsidiary Beeper S.A. de C.V., the source said.
